name: app.R
content:
# =============================================================================
# Ghana GDP Explorer
#
# Reads the GSS quarterly GDP bulletin workbook directly and renders every
# chart as a real ggplot in theme_alfred, made interactive with ggiraph.
# The page shell is bslib: page_navbar, cards, sidebars and value boxes.
#
#   app.R              wiring only
#   R/00_setup.R       theme, palette, chart builders, sparklines and icons
#   R/01_data.R        tolerant readers for the bulletin
#   R/mod_*.R          one Shiny module per view
#
# Files in R/ are sourced automatically by Shiny.
# Requires: shiny, bslib (>= 0.6), tidyverse, ggiraph
#           readxl only when reading a workbook directly (not in the shinylive build)
# =============================================================================

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggiraph)

if (dir.exists("R")) for (f in list.files("R", pattern = "[.][Rr]$", full.names = TRUE)) source(f)

DEFAULT_XLSX <- "gdp_raw.xlsx"
DATA_RDS     <- "data/gdp.rds"   # built by build_data.R; used by the shinylive build

app_theme <- bs_theme(
  version = 5,
  bg = "floralwhite", fg = "#4A4A4A",
  primary = RUST, secondary = "#5F7A8A", success = GREEN, danger = "#7A3B2E",
  "navbar-bg" = TILE[["navy"]],
  "card-border-color" = "#E7DECB",
  "card-cap-bg" = "#F6EFE2",
  "border-radius" = "0.25rem"
)

app_css <- HTML("
  .note { color:#8C8C8C; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; }
  .story { font-size:15px; line-height:1.65; color:#4A4A4A; }
  .card-header { font-weight:700; color:#4D4D4D; font-size:13px;
                 text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; }
  .bslib-value-box .value-box-title { font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700;
                 text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; opacity:0.92; }
  .bslib-value-box .value-box-value { font-size:26px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.15; }
  .bslib-value-box p { margin-bottom:0.15rem; }
  .vb-context { font-size:12px; font-weight:600; opacity:0.9; line-height:1.35; }
  .vb-link a, .vb-link a:hover, .vb-link a:focus {
                 color:#FFFFFF; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700;
                 text-decoration:underline; opacity:0.9; }
  .vb-spark { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:34px;
              opacity:0.45; pointer-events:none; }
  .bslib-value-box .value-box-area { position:relative; }
")

ui <- page_navbar(
  id = "tab",
  title = "Ghana GDP Explorer",
  theme = app_theme,
  fillable = FALSE,
  header = tagList(tags$head(tags$style(app_css))),

  nav_panel("Overview",      mod_overview_ui("overview")),
  nav_panel("Growth",        mod_growth_ui("growth")),
  nav_panel("Contributions", mod_contrib_ui("contrib")),
  nav_panel("Structure",     mod_structure_ui("structure")),
  nav_panel("Levels",        mod_levels_ui("levels")),
  nav_panel("Momentum",      mod_momentum_ui("momentum")),
  nav_panel("Prices",        mod_prices_ui("prices")),
  nav_panel("Data",          mod_data_ui("data")),
  nav_panel(
    "Notes",
    card(
      card_header("How to read this"),
      card_body(
        div(
          style = "max-width:820px;",
          p(strong("Shares are at current prices."), " They move with relative prices as well as
            with real activity. Gold's rising share, for instance, is partly the gold price."),
          p(strong("Growth and contributions are at constant 2013 prices."), " The activity
            contributions add up to published GDP growth. Cocoa, oil and gas, and gold are memo
            items nested inside crops and mining, so they are never mixed into that total."),
          p(strong("Year-on-year against quarter-on-quarter."), " The year-on-year rate compares a
            quarter with the same quarter a year earlier, so it needs no seasonal adjustment but
            turns slowly. The seasonally adjusted quarter-on-quarter rate on the Momentum tab
            turns first and is noisier."),
          p(strong("Partial years."), " The final year in any annual view covers only the quarters
            published so far, so it is not comparable with a full year."),
          p(strong("The informal GDP series is left out."), " It falls from about 58% of GDP in
            2006 to 27% by 2013 and then flattens, which looks like a change in measurement
            rather than real formalisation."),
          p(strong("Estimates are provisional and revised."), " GSS marks recent quarters as
            revised or provisional and restates earlier ones with each release, so numbers here
            will not always match an older bulletin."),
          p(strong("Source."), " Ghana Statistical Service, Quarterly Gross Domestic Product
            Bulletin. Load a later edition from the Overview tab and every view refreshes.")
        )
      )
    )
  ),

  nav_spacer(),
  nav_item(uiOutput("headline", inline = TRUE))
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # the workbook picker lives on the Overview page and reports back here
  upload <- reactiveVal(NULL)

  dat <- reactive({
    up <- upload()
    if (!is.null(up) && can_read_xlsx()) return(load_gdp(up$datapath))
    if (file.exists(DATA_RDS)) return(readRDS(DATA_RDS))
    validate(need(can_read_xlsx() && file.exists(DEFAULT_XLSX),
                  paste0("No data found. Either run build_data.R to create ", DATA_RDS,
                         ", or put the bulletin workbook next to app.R as '",
                         DEFAULT_XLSX, "'.")))
    load_gdp(DEFAULT_XLSX)
  })

  output$headline <- renderUI({
    d <- dat()
    last <- d$yoy |> dplyr::filter(.data$t == max(.data$t))
    g  <- last$value[last$item == "GDP"]
    no <- last$value[last$item == "Non-oil GDP"]
    if (length(g) != 1) return(NULL)
    span(
      style = "color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-weight:600; font-size:13px;",
      sprintf("%s  |  GDP %+.1f%%%s", last$period[1], g,
              if (length(no) == 1) sprintf("  |  non-oil %+.1f%%", no) else "")
    )
  })

  file_in <- mod_overview_server("overview", dat, parent = session)
  observeEvent(file_in(), upload(file_in()), ignoreInit = TRUE)

  mod_growth_server("growth", dat)
  mod_contrib_server("contrib", dat)
  mod_structure_server("structure", dat)
  mod_levels_server("levels", dat)
  mod_momentum_server("momentum", dat)
  mod_prices_server("prices", dat)
  mod_data_server("data", dat)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

name: R/00_setup.R
content:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared look and feel, plus the chart builders every module uses.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

RUST <- "#A9432C"; GREY <- "#8C8C8C"; DARK <- "#4F4F4F"; BG <- "floralwhite"
GREEN <- "#2F6B4F"; LIGHT <- "#C9C2B6"
CAP <- "Data: Ghana Statistical Service, Quarterly GDP Bulletin | Chart: alfredappiah.com"

theme_alfred <- function(base_size = 12) {
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.background   = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = BG, colour = NA),
      panel.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = BG, colour = NA),
      panel.grid        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position   = "none",
      strip.text        = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.title          = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30", size = 16,
                                                  face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 6)),
      plot.subtitle       = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey55", size = 11,
                                                  face = "bold", lineheight = 1.3,
                                                  margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 14)),
      plot.caption        = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 1, colour = "grey55", size = 10,
                                                  face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12)),
      axis.text           = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title          = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x        = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y        = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 10)),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.margin         = ggplot2::margin(16, 20, 12, 16)
    )
}

# girafe wrapper: keeps the ggplot rendering, adds hover, tooltip and PNG export
gf <- function(p, height = 6.2) {
  girafe(
    ggobj = p, width_svg = 9.6, height_svg = height,
    options = list(
      opts_hover(css = "stroke-width:3;opacity:1;"),
      opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.25;"),
      opts_tooltip(css = paste0("background:", BG, ";border:1px solid ", RUST, ";",
                                "padding:6px 9px;font-family:sans-serif;font-weight:bold;",
                                "font-size:12px;color:", DARK, ";border-radius:3px;")),
      opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
      opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
    )
  )
}

pct <- function(x) paste0(format(x, trim = TRUE), "%")

# quarter label for the x axis, e.g. 2026.25 -> "2026Q2"
qlab <- function(t) paste0(floor(t + 1e-6), "Q", round((t - floor(t + 1e-6)) * 4) + 1)

# --- line chart -------------------------------------------------------------
# df needs: t, period, item, value. One item may be highlighted in rust.
line_chart <- function(df, highlight = NULL, title = "", subtitle = "",
                       unit = "%", zero_line = FALSE, facet = FALSE,
                       label_ends = TRUE, digits = 1) {

  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      hl  = !is.null(highlight) & .data$item %in% highlight,
      tip = paste0(.data$item, "\n", .data$period, ": ",
                   sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), .data$value), unit)
    )

  ends <- df |> dplyr::group_by(.data$item) |> dplyr::slice_max(.data$t, n = 1) |> dplyr::ungroup()

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(.data$t, .data$value, group = .data$item))

  if (zero_line) p <- p + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey55", linetype = "dashed")

  if (facet) {
    p <- p +
      geom_line_interactive(ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$item, data_id = .data$item),
                            colour = RUST, linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point_interactive(ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$tip, data_id = .data$item),
                             colour = RUST, size = 1.4, alpha = 0.01) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ item, scales = "free_y")
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_line_interactive(ggplot2::aes(colour = .data$hl, tooltip = .data$item,
                                         data_id = .data$item),
                            linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point_interactive(ggplot2::aes(colour = .data$hl, tooltip = .data$tip,
                                          data_id = .data$item),
                             size = 1.6, alpha = 0.01) +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = RUST, `FALSE` = DARK))
    if (label_ends) {
      p <- p + ggplot2::geom_text(
        data = ends,
        ggplot2::aes(label = paste0(.data$item, "  ",
                                    sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), .data$value), unit),
                     colour = .data$item %in% highlight),
        hjust = -0.06, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold")
    }
  }

  p +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, if (facet || !label_ends) 0.04 else 0.34))) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, unit)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = CAP) +
    theme_alfred()
}

# --- horizontal bar chart ---------------------------------------------------
bar_chart <- function(df, title = "", subtitle = "", xlab = NULL, unit = "",
                      digits = 2, signed = TRUE) {
  fmt <- paste0(if (signed) "%+." else "%.", digits, "f")
  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(item = forcats::fct_reorder(.data$item, .data$value),
                  hl   = .data$value == max(.data$value),
                  tip  = paste0(.data$item, "\n", sprintf(fmt, .data$value), unit))

  ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(.data$value, .data$item, fill = .data$hl)) +
    geom_col_interactive(ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$tip, data_id = .data$item), width = 0.72) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = sprintf(fmt, .data$value),
                                    hjust = ifelse(.data$value >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)),
                       size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", colour = "grey35") +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey35") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = RUST, `FALSE` = GREY)) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0.16)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = xlab, y = NULL, caption = CAP) +
    theme_alfred() + ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank())
}

# --- stacked bars or area over time ----------------------------------------
stack_chart <- function(df, title = "", subtitle = "", unit = "%", area = FALSE,
                        zero_line = FALSE) {
  pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(RUST, "#C98A6B", LIGHT, GREY, DARK))(
    dplyr::n_distinct(df$item))

  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(tip = paste0(.data$item, "\n", .data$period, ": ",
                               sprintf("%.1f", .data$value), unit))

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(.data$t, .data$value, fill = .data$item))
  has_area <- "geom_area_interactive" %in% getNamespaceExports("ggiraph")
  p <- if (area) {
    if (has_area) {
      p + ggiraph::geom_area_interactive(
        ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$item, data_id = .data$item), position = "stack")
    } else {
      p + ggplot2::geom_area(position = "stack")
    }
  } else {
    p + geom_col_interactive(ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$tip, data_id = .data$item),
                             width = 0.22, position = "stack")
  }
  if (zero_line) p <- p + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey35")

  p +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, unit)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = CAP) +
    theme_alfred() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 10,
                                                       face = "bold"))
}

# --- dumbbell: two values per item ------------------------------------------
dumbbell_chart <- function(df, title = "", subtitle = "", lab_a = "a", lab_b = "b") {
  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(item = forcats::fct_reorder(.data$item, .data$b),
                  tip = paste0(.data$item, "\n", lab_a, ": ", sprintf("%.1f%%", .data$a),
                               "\n", lab_b, ": ", sprintf("%.1f%%", .data$b)))

  ggplot2::ggplot(df) +
    geom_segment_interactive(ggplot2::aes(x = .data$a, xend = .data$b, y = .data$item,
                                          yend = .data$item, tooltip = .data$tip,
                                          data_id = .data$item),
                             colour = GREY, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point_interactive(ggplot2::aes(.data$a, .data$item, tooltip = .data$tip,
                                        data_id = .data$item), colour = GREY, size = 4) +
    geom_point_interactive(ggplot2::aes(.data$b, .data$item, tooltip = .data$tip,
                                        data_id = .data$item), colour = RUST, size = 4) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(.data$a, .data$item, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", .data$a),
                                    hjust = ifelse(.data$a <= .data$b, 1.4, -0.4)),
                       size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", colour = "grey35") +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(.data$b, .data$item, label = sprintf("%.0f%%", .data$b),
                                    hjust = ifelse(.data$b < .data$a, 1.4, -0.4)),
                       size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", colour = RUST) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0.14)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = CAP) +
    theme_alfred() + ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank())
}

# --- small shared UI pieces -------------------------------------------------
note <- function(...) div(class = "note", ...)

year_slider <- function(id, years, value = NULL) {
  rng <- range(years, na.rm = TRUE)
  sliderInput(id, "Years", min = rng[1], max = rng[2],
              value = value %||% c(max(rng[1], rng[2] - 11), rng[2]),
              step = 1, sep = "")
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

# TRUE when this build can parse a workbook. The shinylive build ships without
# the reader (and without readxl), so the upload control is hidden there.
can_read_xlsx <- function() {
  exists("load_gdp", mode = "function") && requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE)
}

# --- summary page pieces ----------------------------------------------------

# solid KPI tiles, in the style of a monitoring dashboard
TILE <- c(navy = "#1F3A5F", slate = "#3E5C76", steel = "#5F7A8A", rust = "#A9432C",
          bronze = "#8A6A3B", brick = "#7A3B2E", green = "#2F6B4F", charcoal = "#4A4A4A")

# small inline SVG icons, so there is no icon-font dependency
tile_icon <- function(name, size = 26) {
  body <- switch(
    name,
    "trend-up"   = '<polyline points="2,18 8,11 12,14 22,4"/><polyline points="16,4 22,4 22,10"/>',
    "trend-down" = '<polyline points="2,6 8,13 12,10 22,20"/><polyline points="16,20 22,20 22,14"/>',
    "bars"       = '<rect x="3" y="13" width="4" height="9"/><rect x="10" y="7" width="4" height="15"/><rect x="17" y="10" width="4" height="12"/>',
    "clock"      = '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><polyline points="12,6 12,12 17,14"/>',
    "tag"        = '<path d="M3 12 L12 3 L21 3 L21 12 L12 21 Z"/><circle cx="16.5" cy="7.5" r="1.6"/>',
    "bolt"       = '<polygon points="13,2 4,14 11,14 10,22 20,9 13,9"/>',
    "spark"      = '<polygon points="12,2 14,9 21,12 14,15 12,22 10,15 3,12 10,9"/>',
    "coins"      = '<ellipse cx="12" cy="6" rx="8" ry="3.2"/><path d="M4 6 v6 c0 1.8 3.6 3.2 8 3.2 s8 -1.4 8 -3.2 V6"/><path d="M4 12 v5 c0 1.8 3.6 3.2 8 3.2 s8 -1.4 8 -3.2 v-5"/>',
    '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/>')
  HTML(sprintf(paste0('<svg width="%d" height="%d" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" ',
                      'stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" ',
                      'stroke-linejoin="round">%s</svg>'), size, size, body))
}

# a tiny sparkline; stretches to the tile width when full = TRUE
sparkline_svg <- function(v, colour = RUST, w = 150, h = 34, full = FALSE) {
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if (length(v) < 3) return(NULL)
  rng <- range(v); span <- diff(rng)
  x <- seq(0, w, length.out = length(v))
  y <- if (span == 0) rep(h / 2, length(v)) else h - 3 - (v - rng[1]) / span * (h - 6)
  pts <- paste(sprintf("%.1f,%.1f", x, y), collapse = " ")
  fill_pts <- paste0(pts, sprintf(" %.1f,%d 0,%d", w, h, h))
  zero <- ""
  if (rng[1] < 0 && rng[2] > 0) {
    y0 <- h - 3 - (0 - rng[1]) / span * (h - 6)
    zero <- sprintf('<line x1="0" y1="%.1f" x2="%d" y2="%.1f" stroke="%s" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" opacity="0.6"/>',
                    y0, w, y0, colour)
  }
  HTML(sprintf(paste0('<svg width="%s" height="%d" viewBox="0 0 %d %d" ',
                      'preserveAspectRatio="none" role="img">%s',
                      '<polygon points="%s" fill="%s" opacity="0.22"/>',
                      '<polyline points="%s" fill="none" stroke="%s" stroke-width="2" ',
                      'stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>'),
               if (full) "100%" else as.character(w), h, w, h, zero,
               fill_pts, colour, pts, colour))
}

# an arrow and a change, readable on a coloured tile
delta_chip <- function(now, then, unit = " pp") {
  if (length(now) != 1 || length(then) != 1 || is.na(now) || is.na(then)) return(NULL)
  d <- now - then
  arrow <- if (d > 0.05) "\u25b2" else if (d < -0.05) "\u25bc" else "\u25ac"
  sprintf("%s %+.1f%s on a year earlier", arrow, d, unit)
}

name: R/01_data.R
content:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constants and helpers used at run time. Nothing here touches the Excel
# workbook, so this file loads in webR / shinylive without readxl.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

clean_txt <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_replace_all(x, "[\r\n]", " "))
}

# --- one label per concept, whatever GSS called it in this edition -----------
pretty_item <- function(x) {
  l <- stringr::str_to_lower(clean_txt(x))
  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(l, "non[ -]?oil")                    ~ "Non-oil GDP",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "informal")                       ~ "Informal economy",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "purchaser|overall gdp growth|^total \\(gdp|^total gdp") ~ "GDP",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "^total value added \\(gdp|^gdp at basic prices") ~ "Value added",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "^cocoa$")                        ~ "Cocoa",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "crops")                          ~ "Crops & cocoa",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "livestock")                      ~ "Livestock",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "forestry")                       ~ "Forestry",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "fishing")                        ~ "Fishing",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "oil & gas")                      ~ "Oil & gas",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "^gold$")                         ~ "Gold",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "mining")                         ~ "Mining & quarrying",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "manufactur")                     ~ "Manufacturing",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "electricity")                    ~ "Electricity",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "water")                          ~ "Water & sewerage",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "construction")                   ~ "Construction",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "wholesale|trade; repair")        ~ "Wholesale & retail trade",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "accommodation")                  ~ "Hotels & restaurants",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "transport")                      ~ "Transport & storage",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "information & communication")    ~ "ICT",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "financial & insurance")          ~ "Finance & insurance",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "real estate")                    ~ "Real estate",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "professional")                   ~ "Professional & admin services",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "public administration")          ~ "Public administration",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "^education$")                    ~ "Education",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "health")                         ~ "Health",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "personal service")               ~ "Other personal services",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "net taxes|net indirect taxes")   ~ "Net taxes",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "^agriculture")                   ~ "Agriculture",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "^industry")                      ~ "Industry",
    stringr::str_detect(l, "^service")                       ~ "Services",
    TRUE                                                     ~ clean_txt(x)
  )
}

SECTORS  <- c("Agriculture", "Industry", "Services")
AGGREGATES <- c("GDP", "Non-oil GDP", "Value added", "Agriculture", "Industry", "Services")
MEMO <- c("Cocoa", "Oil & gas", "Gold", "Informal economy")

classify <- function(item) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    item %in% c("GDP", "Non-oil GDP", "Value added") ~ "Headline",
    item %in% SECTORS ~ "Sector",
    item %in% MEMO    ~ "Memo",
    TRUE              ~ "Activity"
  )
}

# choices for a selectInput, grouped by sector so the dropdown has headings
grouped_choices <- function(map, items = NULL) {
  m <- map
  if (!is.null(items)) m <- dplyr::filter(m, .data$item %in% items)
  m <- dplyr::arrange(m, .data$sector, .data$item)
  split(m$item, m$sector)[vapply(split(m$item, m$sector), length, integer(1)) > 0]
}

# annual shares, weighted by the size of each quarter
annual_shares <- function(shares, gva) {
  shares |>
    dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::select(gva, "period", "gva"), by = "period") |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$item, .data$type, year = .data$year) |>
    dplyr::summarise(value = sum(.data$value * .data$gva) / sum(.data$gva),
                     quarters = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(t = .data$year, period = as.character(.data$year))
}

# --- Contributions to growth: who actually moved the number -----------------

mod_contrib_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = sidebar(
      width = 320, open = "open",
      radioButtons(ns("mode"), "View",
                   c("Snapshot" = "snap", "Over time" = "time", "Size vs growth" = "dumb")),
      conditionalPanel(
        sprintf("input['%s'] != 'time'", ns("mode")),
        uiOutput(ns("end_ui")),
        sliderInput(ns("window"), "Quarters averaged", min = 1, max = 8, value = 4, step = 1)
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        sprintf("input['%s'] == 'snap'", ns("mode")),
        radioButtons(ns("level"), "Detail", c("Activities" = "Activity", "Sectors" = "Sector"),
                     inline = TRUE),
        sliderInput(ns("topn"), "Activities shown", min = 5, max = 21, value = 21, step = 1),
        checkboxInput(ns("taxes"), "Include net taxes", TRUE)
      ),
      conditionalPanel(sprintf("input['%s'] == 'time'", ns("mode")), uiOutput(ns("years_ui"))),
      conditionalPanel(
        sprintf("input['%s'] == 'dumb'", ns("mode")),
        sliderInput(ns("nact"), "Activities shown", min = 4, max = 14, value = 7, step = 1)
      ),
      note("Percentage points of real GDP growth. The activity bars add up to total growth; ",
           "cocoa, gold and oil sit inside crops and mining, so they are shown only in the memo view.")
    ),
    card(
      full_screen = TRUE,
      card_header("Contributions to growth"),
      card_body(girafeOutput(ns("plot"), height = "700px")),
      card_footer(downloadButton(ns("dl"), "Download this selection (CSV)"))
    )
  )
}

mod_contrib_server <- function(id, dat) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    ns <- session$ns

    output$end_ui <- renderUI({
      d <- dat()
      selectInput(ns("end"), "Latest quarter", choices = rev(d$periods),
                  selected = dplyr::last(d$periods))
    })

    output$years_ui <- renderUI({
      d <- dat()
      yrs <- sort(unique(d$contrib$year))
      year_slider(ns("years"), yrs)
    })

    window <- reactive({
      d <- dat(); req(input$end, input$window)
      ps <- d$periods
      i <- match(input$end, ps)
      ps[max(1, i - input$window + 1):i]
    })

    plot_data <- reactive({
      d <- dat()

      if (identical(input$mode, "time")) {
        req(input$years)
        return(d$contrib |>
                 dplyr::filter(.data$type == "Sector" | .data$item == "Net taxes",
                               .data$year >= input$years[1], .data$year <= input$years[2]))
      }

      w <- window()

      if (identical(input$mode, "dumb")) {
        req(input$nact)
        total <- d$contrib |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$item == "GDP", .data$period %in% w) |>
          dplyr::summarise(v = mean(.data$value)) |> dplyr::pull(.data$v)
        latest_year <- max(d$shares$year)
        sh <- d$shares |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$type == "Activity", .data$year == latest_year) |>
          dplyr::group_by(.data$item) |>
          dplyr::summarise(a = mean(.data$value), .groups = "drop")
        cg <- d$contrib |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$type == "Activity", .data$period %in% w) |>
          dplyr::group_by(.data$item) |>
          dplyr::summarise(b = mean(.data$value) / total * 100, .groups = "drop")
        return(dplyr::inner_join(sh, cg, by = "item") |>
                 dplyr::slice_max(.data$a, n = input$nact))
      }

      req(input$level)
      out <- d$contrib |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$period %in% w) |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$type == input$level |
                        (input$level == "Sector" & .data$item == "Net taxes")) |>
        dplyr::group_by(.data$item) |>
        dplyr::summarise(value = mean(.data$value), .groups = "drop")

      if (!isTRUE(input$taxes)) out <- dplyr::filter(out, .data$item != "Net taxes")
      if (identical(input$level, "Activity")) {
        out <- out |> dplyr::slice_max(abs(.data$value), n = input$topn)
      }
      out
    })

    output$plot <- renderGirafe({
      d <- dat(); df <- plot_data()
      validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data for that selection."))

      if (identical(input$mode, "time")) {
        return(gf(stack_chart(
          df, area = FALSE, zero_line = TRUE, unit = "",
          title = "Where Growth Came From, Quarter by Quarter",
          subtitle = "Contribution to real GDP growth by sector. The bars add up to total growth."),
          height = 6.6))
      }

      w <- window()
      lab <- if (length(w) == 1) w else paste0(w[1], " to ", dplyr::last(w))

      if (identical(input$mode, "dumb")) {
        return(gf(dumbbell_chart(
          df, lab_a = "share of value added", lab_b = "share of growth",
          title = "Size of the Activity Against Its Share of the Growth",
          subtitle = paste0("Grey: share of value added, ", max(d$shares$year),
                            ". Red: share of all GDP growth, ", lab, ".")),
          height = 6.2))
      }

      total <- d$contrib |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$item == "GDP", .data$period %in% w) |>
        dplyr::summarise(v = mean(.data$value)) |> dplyr::pull(.data$v)
      top <- df |> dplyr::slice_max(.data$value, n = 1)

      gf(bar_chart(
        df, unit = "",
        title = "What Is Driving Ghana's Growth",
        subtitle = sprintf("Contribution to real GDP growth, %s.\nGDP growth averaged %.1f%%; %s supplied %.0f%% of it.",
                           lab, total, top$item[1], top$value[1] / total * 100),
        xlab = "Percentage points of GDP growth"),
        height = if (identical(input$level, "Activity")) 8.2 else 4.6)
    })

    output$dl <- downloadHandler(
      filename = \() paste0("ghana_gdp_contributions_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
      content  = \(f) readr::write_csv(plot_data(), f)
    )
  })
}

# --- Data browser: every processed table, wide, with a download -------------

mod_data_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = sidebar(
      width = 320, open = "open",
      selectInput(ns("set"), "Table",
                  c("Shares of value added" = "shares",
                    "Contributions to growth" = "contrib",
                    "Year-on-year growth" = "yoy",
                    "Value added levels" = "va",
                    "Seasonally adjusted (q/q)" = "sa",
                    "Deflators (y/y)" = "defl")),
      conditionalPanel(sprintf("input['%s'] == 'va'", ns("set")),
                       radioButtons(ns("measure"), "Prices",
                                    c("Constant 2013 prices", "Current prices"))),
      sliderInput(ns("rows"), "Quarters shown", min = 4, max = 40, value = 12, step = 4),
      note("The download gives the full series, not just the quarters on screen.")
    ),
    card(
      full_screen = TRUE,
      card_header("Processed data"),
      card_body(div(style = "overflow-x:auto;", tableOutput(ns("tbl")))),
      card_footer(downloadButton(ns("dl"), "Download this table (CSV)"))
    )
  )
}

mod_data_server <- function(id, dat) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {

    long <- reactive({
      d <- dat(); req(input$set)
      out <- switch(input$set,
                    shares  = d$shares,
                    contrib = d$contrib,
                    yoy     = d$yoy,
                    va      = { req(input$measure)
                                dplyr::filter(d$va, .data$measure == input$measure) },
                    sa      = d$sa,
                    defl    = d$defl)
      validate(need(!is.null(out) && nrow(out) > 0, "That table is not in this workbook."))
      out
    })

    wide <- reactive({
      long() |>
        dplyr::select("period", "t", "item", "value") |>
        dplyr::arrange(.data$t) |>
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "item", values_from = "value") |>
        dplyr::select(-"t")
    })

    output$tbl <- renderTable({
      w <- wide()
      utils::tail(w, input$rows) |>
        dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2)))
    }, striped = TRUE, spacing = "xs", digits = 2)

    output$dl <- downloadHandler(
      filename = \() paste0("ghana_gdp_", input$set, "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
      content  = \(f) readr::write_csv(wide(), f)
    )
  })
}

# --- Levels: value added in cedis, indexed, or as its own growth rate -------

mod_levels_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = sidebar(
      width = 320, open = "open",
      radioButtons(ns("measure"), "Prices",
                   c("Constant 2013 prices" = "Constant 2013 prices",
                     "Current prices" = "Current prices")),
      uiOutput(ns("items_ui")),
      uiOutput(ns("hl_ui")),
      radioButtons(ns("trans"), "Show as",
                   c("Value added (GHS million)" = "level",
                     "Index, base quarter = 100" = "index",
                     "Year-on-year change" = "yoy")),
      conditionalPanel(sprintf("input['%s'] == 'index'", ns("trans")),
                       uiOutput(ns("base_ui"))),
      conditionalPanel(sprintf("input['%s'] == 'level'", ns("trans")),
                       checkboxInput(ns("log"), "Log scale", FALSE)),
      uiOutput(ns("years_ui")),
      note("Constant prices strip out inflation and show real volumes. Current prices ",
           "are what was actually spent, so they grow with prices as well as output.")
    ),
    card(
      full_screen = TRUE,
      card_header("Value added"),
      card_body(girafeOutput(ns("plot"), height = "620px")),
      card_footer(downloadButton(ns("dl"), "Download this selection (CSV)"))
    )
  )
}

mod_levels_server <- function(id, dat) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    ns <- session$ns

    avail <- reactive({
      d <- dat(); req(input$measure)
      items <- d$va |> dplyr::filter(.data$measure == input$measure) |>
        dplyr::distinct(.data$item) |> dplyr::pull(.data$item)
      d$sector_map |>
        dplyr::mutate(sector = as.character(.data$sector)) |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$item %in% items)
    })

    output$items_ui <- renderUI({
      m <- avail()
      selectInput(ns("items"), "Activities", multiple = TRUE,
                  choices = grouped_choices(m),
                  selected = intersect(c("GDP", "Non-oil GDP"), m$item))
    })

    output$hl_ui <- renderUI({
      req(input$items)
      selectInput(ns("hl"), "Highlight", choices = input$items, selected = input$items[1])
    })

    output$years_ui <- renderUI({
      d <- dat(); year_slider(ns("years"), sort(unique(d$va$year)))
    })

    output$base_ui <- renderUI({
      d <- dat()
      ps <- sort(unique(d$va$period))
      selectInput(ns("base"), "Base quarter", choices = ps, selected = ps[1])
    })

    plot_data <- reactive({
      d <- dat(); req(input$items, input$measure, input$trans, input$years)
      out <- d$va |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$measure == input$measure, .data$item %in% input$items) |>
        dplyr::arrange(.data$item, .data$t)

      out <- switch(input$trans,
        "level" = out,
        "yoy" = out |>
          dplyr::group_by(.data$item) |>
          dplyr::mutate(value = (.data$value / dplyr::lag(.data$value, 4) - 1) * 100) |>
          dplyr::ungroup() |>
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$value)),
        "index" = {
          req(input$base)
          out |>
            dplyr::group_by(.data$item) |>
            dplyr::mutate(base = .data$value[match(input$base, .data$period)],
                          value = .data$value / .data$base * 100) |>
            dplyr::ungroup() |>
            dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$value)) |>
            dplyr::select(-"base")
        })

      out |> dplyr::filter(.data$year >= input$years[1], .data$year <= input$years[2])
    })

    output$plot <- renderGirafe({
      df <- plot_data()
      validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data for that selection."))

      unit   <- if (identical(input$trans, "yoy")) "%" else ""
      digits <- if (identical(input$trans, "level")) 0 else 1
      title  <- switch(input$trans,
                       "level" = "Value Added, Quarter by Quarter",
                       "index" = paste0("Indexed to ", input$base, " = 100"),
                       "yoy"   = "Year-on-Year Change in Value Added")
      sub <- paste0(input$measure,
                    if (identical(input$trans, "level")) ", GHS million" else "")

      p <- line_chart(df, highlight = input$hl, title = title, subtitle = sub,
                      unit = unit, digits = digits,
                      zero_line = identical(input$trans, "yoy"))
      if (identical(input$trans, "level") && isTRUE(input$log)) {
        p <- p + ggplot2::scale_y_log10()
      }
      gf(p, height = 6.2)
    })

    output$dl <- downloadHandler(
      filename = \() paste0("ghana_gdp_levels_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
      content  = \(f) readr::write_csv(plot_data(), f)
    )
  })
}

# --- Overview: the quarter at a glance, on bslib value boxes ----------------

mod_overview_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  tagList(
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(4, 8),
      card(
        card_header("Source workbook"),
        card_body(
          uiOutput(ns("period_ui")),
          fileInput(ns("file"), NULL, accept = ".xlsx", width = "100%",
                    buttonLabel = "Choose bulletin", placeholder = "gdp_raw.xlsx"),
          note("Pick any quarter and the whole page rewrites itself. ",
               "Load a later edition of the bulletin and every tab follows.")
        )
      ),
      card(
        card_header("The quarter in a paragraph"),
        card_body(uiOutput(ns("story")))
      )
    ),
    uiOutput(ns("boxes")),
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(6, 6),
      card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header("Who moved the number"),
           card_body(girafeOutput(ns("p_contrib"), height = "430px"))),
      card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header("The last eight years"),
           card_body(girafeOutput(ns("p_growth"), height = "430px")))
    )
  )
}

mod_overview_server <- function(id, dat, parent = NULL) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    ns <- session$ns

    output$period_ui <- renderUI({
      d <- dat()
      selectInput(ns("period"), "Quarter", choices = rev(d$periods),
                  selected = dplyr::last(d$periods), width = "100%")
    })

    # everything the page needs for the chosen quarter
    snap <- reactive({
      d <- dat(); req(input$period)
      t_now <- d$contrib$t[match(input$period, d$contrib$period)]

      pick <- function(tbl, it, tt = t_now) {
        if (is.null(tbl)) return(NA_real_)
        v <- tbl$value[tbl$item == it & abs(tbl$t - tt) < 1e-6]
        if (length(v) == 1) v else NA_real_
      }
      hist <- function(tbl, it, n = 12) {
        if (is.null(tbl)) return(numeric())
        tbl |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$item == it, .data$t <= t_now) |>
          dplyr::arrange(.data$t) |> dplyr::pull(.data$value) |> utils::tail(n)
      }

      act <- d$contrib |> dplyr::filter(.data$type == "Activity", abs(.data$t - t_now) < 1e-6)
      act_items <- d$yoy |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$sector != "Aggregates", !.data$item %in% SECTORS,
                      abs(.data$t - t_now) < 1e-6)
      size <- d$va |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$measure == "Current prices", .data$item == "GDP",
                      .data$t <= t_now) |>
        dplyr::arrange(.data$t) |> dplyr::pull(.data$value) |> utils::tail(4)

      list(
        t = t_now, period = input$period,
        gdp = pick(d$yoy, "GDP"), gdp_prev = pick(d$yoy, "GDP", t_now - 1),
        nonoil = pick(d$yoy, "Non-oil GDP"), nonoil_prev = pick(d$yoy, "Non-oil GDP", t_now - 1),
        qoq = pick(d$sa, "GDP"), qoq_prev = pick(d$sa, "GDP", t_now - 1),
        defl = pick(d$defl, "GDP"), defl_prev = pick(d$defl, "GDP", t_now - 1),
        gdp_h = hist(d$yoy, "GDP"), nonoil_h = hist(d$yoy, "Non-oil GDP"),
        qoq_h = hist(d$sa, "GDP"), defl_h = hist(d$defl, "GDP"),
        top = act |> dplyr::slice_max(.data$value, n = 1),
        drag = act |> dplyr::slice_min(.data$value, n = 1),
        fastest = act_items |> dplyr::slice_max(.data$value, n = 1),
        weakest = act_items |> dplyr::slice_min(.data$value, n = 1),
        size = if (length(size) == 4) sum(size) else NA_real_,
        contrib_now = act
      )
    })

    # a value box in one of the tile colours, with an optional sparkline
    vb <- function(title, value, context, icon, colour, spark = NULL, link_id = NULL) {
      value_box(
        title = title,
        value = value,
        showcase = tile_icon(icon, 30),
        showcase_layout = showcase_left_center(),
        theme = value_box_theme(bg = colour, fg = "#FFFFFF"),
        height = "180px",
        if (!is.null(context)) p(class = "vb-context", context),
        if (!is.null(link_id)) p(class = "vb-link", actionLink(ns(link_id), "View details")),
        if (!is.null(spark)) div(class = "vb-spark", spark)
      )
    }

    output$boxes <- renderUI({
      s <- snap()
      validate(need(!is.na(s$gdp), "No published growth rate for that quarter."))
      white <- "#FFFFFF"

      tagList(
        layout_column_wrap(
          width = 1/4, gap = "1rem", heights_equal = "row",
          vb("Real GDP growth", sprintf("%+.1f%%", s$gdp), delta_chip(s$gdp, s$gdp_prev),
             "trend-up", TILE[["navy"]], sparkline_svg(s$gdp_h, white, full = TRUE), "go1"),
          vb("Non-oil growth", sprintf("%+.1f%%", s$nonoil), delta_chip(s$nonoil, s$nonoil_prev),
             "trend-up", TILE[["slate"]], sparkline_svg(s$nonoil_h, white, full = TRUE), "go2"),
          vb("Quarter on quarter",
             if (is.na(s$qoq)) "n/a" else sprintf("%+.1f%%", s$qoq),
             if (is.na(s$qoq)) "seasonally adjusted" else delta_chip(s$qoq, s$qoq_prev),
             "clock", TILE[["steel"]], sparkline_svg(s$qoq_h, white, full = TRUE), "go3"),
          vb("Price change",
             if (is.na(s$defl)) "n/a" else sprintf("%+.1f%%", s$defl),
             if (is.na(s$defl)) "GDP deflator" else delta_chip(s$defl, s$defl_prev),
             "tag", TILE[["rust"]], sparkline_svg(s$defl_h, white, full = TRUE), "go4")
        ),
        div(style = "height:1rem;"),
        layout_column_wrap(
          width = 1/4, gap = "1rem", heights_equal = "row",
          vb("Biggest engine", s$top$item[1],
             sprintf("%+.2f points, %.0f%% of all the growth",
                     s$top$value[1], s$top$value[1] / s$gdp * 100),
             "bolt", TILE[["bronze"]], NULL, "go5"),
          vb("Biggest drag", s$drag$item[1], sprintf("%+.2f points", s$drag$value[1]),
             "trend-down", TILE[["brick"]], NULL, "go6"),
          vb("Fastest growing", s$fastest$item[1],
             sprintf("%+.1f%% on a year earlier", s$fastest$value[1]),
             "spark", TILE[["green"]], NULL, "go7"),
          vb("Economy size",
             if (is.na(s$size)) "n/a" else if (s$size >= 1e6)
               sprintf("GHS %.2f tn", s$size / 1e6) else sprintf("GHS %.0f bn", s$size / 1e3),
             "current prices, last four quarters",
             "coins", TILE[["charcoal"]], NULL, "go8")
        )
      )
    })

    # the box links move the reader to the tab that explains the number
    if (!is.null(parent)) {
      jumps <- c(go1 = "Growth", go2 = "Growth", go3 = "Momentum", go4 = "Prices",
                 go5 = "Contributions", go6 = "Contributions", go7 = "Growth",
                 go8 = "Levels")
      lapply(names(jumps), function(k) {
        observeEvent(input[[k]], nav_select("tab", jumps[[k]], session = parent),
                     ignoreInit = TRUE)
      })
    }

    output$story <- renderUI({
      s <- snap()
      validate(need(!is.na(s$gdp) && nrow(s$top) == 1, ""))
      txt <- sprintf(
        paste0("In %s the economy grew %.1f%% on the same quarter a year earlier. ",
               "%s did most of the work, adding %.2f percentage points, or %.0f%% of all the ",
               "growth in the quarter. %s took the most off, at %.2f points. ",
               "The fastest expansion anywhere in the economy was %s, up %.1f%%, ",
               "and the weakest was %s at %+.1f%%."),
        s$period, s$gdp, s$top$item[1], s$top$value[1], s$top$value[1] / s$gdp * 100,
        s$drag$item[1], s$drag$value[1],
        s$fastest$item[1], s$fastest$value[1],
        s$weakest$item[1], s$weakest$value[1])
      if (!is.na(s$defl)) {
        txt <- paste0(txt, sprintf(
          " Prices across the economy rose %.1f%%, so most of the growth in cedis was real.",
          s$defl))
      }
      div(class = "story", txt)
    })

    output$p_contrib <- renderGirafe({
      s <- snap()
      df <- s$contrib_now |> dplyr::slice_max(abs(.data$value), n = 8) |>
        dplyr::select("item", "value")
      gf(bar_chart(df, title = "Who Moved the Number",
                   subtitle = paste0("Contribution to GDP growth, ", s$period),
                   xlab = "Percentage points"),
         height = 4.3)
    })

    output$p_growth <- renderGirafe({
      d <- dat(); s <- snap()
      df <- d$yoy |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$item %in% c("GDP", "Non-oil GDP"),
                      .data$t <= s$t, .data$t > s$t - 8)
      gf(line_chart(df, highlight = "GDP", title = "The Last Eight Years",
                    subtitle = "Year-on-year growth, GDP and non-oil GDP",
                    unit = "%", zero_line = TRUE),
         height = 4.3)
    })

    # the workbook picker lives on this page; hand the upload back to app.R
    reactive(input$file)
  })
}

# --- Prices vs volumes: how much of the growth in cedis is just prices ------

mod_prices_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = sidebar(
      width = 320, open = "open",
      uiOutput(ns("item_ui")),
      uiOutput(ns("years_ui")),
      checkboxGroupInput(ns("series"), "Series",
                         choices = c("Nominal growth", "Real growth", "Price change (deflator)"),
                         selected = c("Nominal growth", "Real growth", "Price change (deflator)")),
      note("Nominal growth is what value added did in cedis. Real growth strips out prices. ",
           "The deflator is the price part. The gap between the first two is the price story.")
    ),
    card(
      full_screen = TRUE,
      card_header("Prices and volumes"),
      card_body(girafeOutput(ns("plot"), height = "600px")),
      card_footer(downloadButton(ns("dl"), "Download this selection (CSV)"))
    )
  )
}

mod_prices_server <- function(id, dat) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    ns <- session$ns

    choices <- reactive({
      d <- dat()
      if (is.null(d$defl)) return(character())
      intersect(unique(d$defl$item), unique(d$yoy$item))
    })

    output$item_ui <- renderUI({
      ch <- choices()
      if (length(ch) == 0) return(note("This edition of the workbook has no deflator table."))
      selectInput(ns("item"), "Sector", choices = ch,
                  selected = if ("GDP" %in% ch) "GDP" else ch[1])
    })

    output$years_ui <- renderUI({
      d <- dat(); year_slider(ns("years"), d$years)
    })

    plot_data <- reactive({
      d <- dat(); req(input$item, input$years, input$series)

      real <- d$yoy |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$item == input$item) |>
        dplyr::transmute(.data$period, .data$t, .data$year,
                         item = "Real growth", .data$value)

      price <- d$defl |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$item == input$item) |>
        dplyr::transmute(.data$period, .data$t, .data$year,
                         item = "Price change (deflator)", .data$value)

      nominal <- d$va |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$measure == "Current prices", .data$item == input$item) |>
        dplyr::arrange(.data$t) |>
        dplyr::mutate(value = (.data$value / dplyr::lag(.data$value, 4) - 1) * 100) |>
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$value)) |>
        dplyr::transmute(.data$period, .data$t, .data$year,
                         item = "Nominal growth", .data$value)

      dplyr::bind_rows(nominal, real, price) |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$item %in% input$series,
                      .data$year >= input$years[1], .data$year <= input$years[2])
    })

    output$plot <- renderGirafe({
      validate(need(length(choices()) > 0, "No deflator table in this workbook."))
      df <- plot_data()
      validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No data for that selection."))
      gf(line_chart(df, highlight = "Price change (deflator)",
                    title = paste0("Prices or Volumes: ", input$item),
                    subtitle = "Year-on-year change. Nominal growth is real growth plus price change.",
                    unit = "%", zero_line = TRUE),
         height = 6.0)
    })

    output$dl <- downloadHandler(
      filename = \() paste0("ghana_gdp_prices_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
      content  = \(f) readr::write_csv(plot_data(), f)
    )
  })
}
